about: Bécancour is a city in Centre-du-Québec on the south shore of the St. Lawrence River opposite Trois-Rivières, at the mouth of the Rivière Bécancour. A large industrial park, riverfront neighbourhoods, and a mix of urban and rural territory define the community. About 14,000 people live in Bécancour.
